'''Nebula Leader''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the leader of [[Nebula Flight]], a part of the [[Corellian Home Fleet|Corellian defense fleet]] that fought for the [[Five Worlds]] during the [[Battle of Tralus (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tralus]]. A [[Unidentified pilot (Nebula Leader)|pilot]] flew under the call sign during the battle.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Betrayal" />
